title: Cody Rhodes: finish the story
summary: Cody returns to WWE chasing the championship his father never held. A WrestleMania setback becomes another year of pursuit, ending against Roman Reigns under Bloodline Rules.

chapters.title: Cody returns to WWE
chapters.result: Rhodes defeats Seth Rollins in his return match.
chapters.context: The comeback opens a new chapter in Cody’s WWE career.

chapters.title: Roman denies the first ending
chapters.result: Reigns retains against Rhodes with Bloodline interference.
chapters.context: The defeat extends Cody’s championship pursuit.

chapters.title: Cody finishes the story
chapters.result: Rhodes defeats Reigns to become Undisputed WWE Universal Champion.
chapters.context: The Bloodline Rules match ends Roman’s championship reign.
